scope: PERIOD on all three reviewed CVEs; Serial only on CVE-2016-7911 and CVE-2016-9806
scope_reason: The candidate Serial driver records non-reproducible failure schedules for CVE-2017-15265 (schedules 7 and 49 did not replay; only schedule 11 did). PERIOD also produced one non-reproducible early schedule for that case, so any attempt whose replay runs but does not reproduce is recorded as invalid_replay, kept for audit, and excluded from aggregate metrics without replacement.
ordering: attempt-major; method-major; method subjects in listed order; sequential
replay: first saved failure of every completed search; a replay dry-run ASan abort is retried up to 3 attempts and every attempt is kept
dry_run_abort_policy: aborted_at_dry_run counts in the attempt denominator; it is not replayed and not replaced
replay_invalid_policy: a replay that runs to Perform Reproduction! but does not show the expected diagnostic is recorded as invalid_replay; its search row is kept for audit, excluded from aggregate metrics, and no replacement run is made
replay_unverified_policy: if all replay attempts abort in dry run, record replay_unverified and continue; report the count
stopping_rule: stop for inspection on build failure, timeout, search abort after DBDS started, replay timeout, or changed originals
